sections.title: Glass, live
sections.intro: A HUD: glowing cyan arcs and thin digits floating in brackets, no round gauges. This is the real wallpaper, drawn in your browser by the app's own code. Tap the big gauge, and try Glass's layouts and colours.

qr.alt: A QR code that opens Speedometer Live Wallpaper on Google Play

labels.screen: Speedometer Live Wallpaper, live: tap the big gauge to switch it
labels.gauge: Tap the big gauge to switch between power, CPU clock and speed, as on your phone.
labels.getNote: A browser can’t set your wallpaper. Get the app on Google Play, open Styles and pick this one.

sections.title: About Glass
sections.intro: Glass has no round gauges at all: glowing cyan arcs and thin, letter-spaced digits float in corner brackets over smoked glass and faint scan lines. Warnings glow pink-red.

items.alt: The Glass style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Glass, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €2.39, once
items.text: Buy Glass once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Glass's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.

image.alt: The Cockpit style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Cockpit
items.text: An aircraft panel: caption lights, luminous drum counters and a clock on a riveted plate.

image.alt: The Harbour style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Harbour
items.text: Marine instruments: brass rope-edge bezels around navy enamel on a teak deck, a gold needle and brass-framed counters.

image.alt: The Track Night style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Track Night
items.text: A race screen: a rev ladder, the value huge on an electric-blue band, and shift lights closing in from both sides.

image.alt: The Torque style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Torque
items.text: A muscle-car dash: a curved rev arc with a red shift zone, a big round dial on gunmetal, the time as a framed gear number, and fuel and temperature arcs.
